description: This file contains shell script functions related to preparing and running build, test, and validation gates for a software project, including handling changelog updates, checking modified files, and managing build dependencies.

methods.name: run_prepare_push_retry_gates
methods.description: Sets up dependencies, runs build and check commands, and optionally tests code changes, also manages changelog updates and determines if only documentation files have changed.

methods.name: prepare_gates
methods.description: Prepares the project's working state for a pull request by checking changed files, handling changelog requirements, building dependencies, and running tests as needed.
